title: Disclaimer: This is not an officially supported Google product.
summary: Builds on LILA, our open-source method for featurising pixels from dynamic 3D scenes with linear in-context learners: dense visual representations learned from video using optical flow and monocular depth cues, evaluated on DAVIS, COCO-Stuff, and NYUv2. We are scaling the released DINOv2-based checkpoints toward a vision-portfolio dense-feature service.
